tasks.label: NPM RUN BUILD
tasks.command: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version --ignore-scripts && npm run build && notify-send 'VS Code' '✅ MAX COMPONENTS UI - Build concluído e versão incrementada. Faça commit pelo MaxCode antes do deploy.' -i software-update-available && paplay /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/service-login.oga

tasks.label: NPM RUN RELEASE
tasks.command: npm run build && git add . && git commit -m 'feat: atualizando componentes' && npm run release && notify-send 'VS Code' '🚀 MAX COMPONENTS UI - Release enviado com sucesso!' -i software-update-available && paplay /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/service-login.oga
